bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to education; appropriating money for a grant for hospitality education.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. HOSPITALITY MINNESOTA EDUCATION FOUNDATION; APPROPRIATION.

Subdivision 1.

Commissioner of education.

The sums indicated in this section are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of education in the fiscal years designated.

Subd. 2.

Hospitality Minnesota Education Foundation.

(a) For grants to the Hospitality Minnesota Education Foundation for the ProStart hospitality and tourism management program, a statewide initiative in high schools to address the critical workforce shortages in hospitality:

$

250,000

.....

2026

$

250,000

.....

2027

(b) Grant money must be used by the recipient to provide students culinary and management education curriculum, tools, skills, professional development opportunities within the hospitality industry, and scholarships.

(c) This is a onetime appropriation.
additions: The sums indicated in this section are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of education in the fiscal years designated.

(a) For grants to the Hospitality Minnesota Education Foundation for the ProStart hospitality and tourism management program, a statewide initiative in high schools to address the critical workforce shortages in hospitality:

(b) Grant money must be used by the recipient to provide students culinary and management education curriculum, tools, skills, professional development opportunities within the hospitality industry, and scholarships.

Senate.text: Withdrawn and re-referred to Jobs and Economic Development
